name: AP_TERMS_LINES_
description: AP_TERMS_LINES contains detail information about payment terms you define. AP_TERMS_LINES_ is the audit table for AP_TERMS_LINES.

columns.description: A unique identifier for the payment term.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Number of the payment term line.
